additiveDetail.hr: Biljni liker / bitter — destilat s cimetom, klinčićem i tajnom mješavinom bilja (EU kategorija likera, ne whisky/brandy).
additiveDetail.en: Herbal liqueur / bitter — distillate with cinnamon, clove and a secret herb blend (EU liqueur category, not whisky/brandy).

notes.hr: Češki nacionalni bitter od 1807. — cimet i klinčić u ledene čaši. Uz cigaru radi kao digestiv nakon jela, ne kao koktel baza.
notes.en: Czech national bitter since 1807 — cinnamon and clove in an ice-cold glass. With a cigar it works as an after-dinner digestif, not a cocktail base.

additiveDetail.hr: Mađarski biljni bitter — liker na bazi alkohola i biljne mješavine (EU kategorija likera).
additiveDetail.en: Hungarian herbal bitter — alcohol-based liqueur with a herb blend (EU liqueur category).

notes.hr: Mađarska ikona od 1790. — tamniji i gorkiji od Becherovke. Neat uz punu cigaru; tradicija kaže jedan gutljaj nakon jela.
notes.en: Hungarian icon since 1790 — darker and more bitter than Becherovka. Neat with a full cigar; tradition calls for one sip after the meal.

additiveDetail.hr: Fernet — italijanski biljni amaro/bitter (EU liker); menta i gorka biljna baza, ne destilat žitarica.
additiveDetail.en: Fernet — Italian herbal amaro/bitter (EU liqueur); mint and bitter herb base, not a grain distillate.

notes.hr: Klasični milanski fernet — intenzivna menta i gorka biljna tajna. Servirajte ledeno hladno; uz cigar nakon večere, ne prije.
notes.en: The classic Milanese fernet — intense mint and a bitter herbal secret. Serve ice-cold; with a cigar after dinner, not before.

additiveDetail.hr: Sicilijanski amaro — biljni liker s nižim ABV-om (29%); EU kategorija likera/amaro.
additiveDetail.en: Sicilian amaro — herbal liqueur at lower ABV (29%); EU liqueur/amaro category.

notes.hr: Sicilijski amaro od 1868. — pristupačniji od ferneta, blaža slatko-gorka ravnoteža. Neat ili s ledom uz medium do punu cigaru.
notes.en: Sicilian amaro since 1868 — more approachable than fernet, a gentler sweet-bitter balance. Neat or on ice with medium to full cigars.

additiveDetail.hr: Amaro na bazi grappe — biljni liker (EU kategorija likera), ne starija grappa sama po sebi.
additiveDetail.en: Grappa-based amaro — herbal liqueur (EU liqueur category), not aged grappa on its own.

notes.hr: Amaro obitelji Nonino — grappa baza s biljnim destilatom. Finiji od masovnih amara; uz cigar kao digestiv nakon jela.
notes.en: Amaro from the Nonino family — grappa base with herbal distillate. Finer than mass-market amari; with a cigar as an after-dinner digestif.

additiveDetail.hr: Monastički biljni liker — 130 biljaka po receptu kartuzijanaca (EU kategorija likera).
additiveDetail.en: Monastic herbal liqueur — 130 plants per the Carthusian recipe (EU liqueur category).

notes.hr: Zelena Chartreuse (55%) — herbaceous, slojevit, visok ABV. Jedan gutljaj neat u maloj čaši; uz punu cigaru nakon jela.
notes.en: Green Chartreuse (55%) — herbaceous, layered, high ABV. One neat sip in a small glass; with a full cigar after the meal.

additiveDetail.hr: Monastički biljni liker — blaža žuta verzija iste kartuzijanske tradicije (EU kategorija likera).
additiveDetail.en: Monastic herbal liqueur — gentler yellow version of the same Carthusian tradition (EU liqueur category).

notes.hr: Žuta Chartreuse (43%) — mekša i slatkša od Verte. Bolji izbor uz medium cigaru nego zelena verzija.
notes.en: Yellow Chartreuse (43%) — softer and sweeter than Verte. A better pick with medium cigars than the green version.

additiveDetail.hr: Francuski biljni liker — med i 27 biljaka (EU kategorija likera, ne konjak/brandy).
additiveDetail.en: French herbal liqueur — honey and 27 plants (EU liqueur category, not cognac/brandy).

notes.hr: Benediktinski liker od 1510. — med, bilje i začini. Slatkiji digestiv uz medium do punu cigaru; B&B mješavina je druga priča.
notes.en: Benedictine liqueur since 1510 — honey, herbs and spice. A sweeter digestif with medium to full cigars; the B&B blend is a different story.

additiveDetail.hr: Talijanski žuti biljni liker sa safranom — 70 biljaka (EU kategorija likera).
additiveDetail.en: Italian yellow herbal liqueur with saffron — 70 plants (EU liqueur category).

notes.hr: Benevento od 1860. — prepoznatljiv safran i žuta boja. Neat uz medium cigaru; slatko-gorka, ne desertni liker.
notes.en: Benevento since 1860 — distinctive saffron and yellow colour. Neat with a medium cigar; sweet-bitter, not a dessert liqueur.

additiveDetail.hr: Talijanski žuti biljni liker — vanilija i biljna mješavina (EU kategorija likera).
additiveDetail.en: Italian yellow herbal liqueur — vanilla and herb blend (EU liqueur category).

notes.hr: Visoki bočni flakon — vanilija i bilje. Slatkiji od Strega; neat je moguć uz medium cigaru, ali češće ide u koktele.
notes.en: The tall side bottle — vanilla and herbs. Sweeter than Strega; neat works with medium cigars, but it more often lands in cocktails.

additiveDetail.hr: Hrvatski pelinkovac — biljni liker s pelinom (EU kategorija likera).
additiveDetail.en: Croatian pelinkovac — wormwood herbal liqueur (EU liqueur category).

notes.hr: Istarski craft pelinkovac — gorki, pelin-forward profil. Lokalni digestiv uz cigaru; hladniji servis smanjuje gorkoću.
notes.en: Istrian craft pelinkovac — bitter, wormwood-forward profile. A local digestif with cigars; colder service tames the bitterness.

additiveDetail.hr: Botanički liker s listom koke — destilat i ekstrakti bilja (EU kategorija likera; nije rum niti whisky).
additiveDetail.en: Botanical liqueur with coca leaf — distillate and herb extracts (EU liqueur category; not rum or whisky).

notes.hr: Jedinstvena boca — koka-list, menta i zeleni čaj. Nema zamjene u katalogu; neat ili s ledom uz medium cigaru.
notes.en: A one-of-a-kind bottle — coca leaf, mint and green tea. No substitute in the catalog; neat or on ice with a medium cigar.
